prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: revised 3×3 sad-emotion lower-half speech mouth atlas for a 64×29 NPC portrait
Input image: Image 1 is the immutable approved mouth grid and the sole geometry, scale, palette, framing, and pose reference.
Primary request: create one revised, subdued sad mouth sheet. Preserve exact 3×3 lower-half layout, cell boundaries, and mouth anchors.
Style/medium: retain the original soft muted low-contrast pixel-art palette, skin shading, and small natural pixel structure. Keep facial anatomy consistent with reference.
Composition/framing: full 3×3 lower-half sheet, same aspect ratio about 2.20690, no crop, resizing, gutters, or added dividers. Row-major A B C / D E F / G H X.
Lighting/mood: restrained sadness: low-energy and gently subdued. Lip corners relax slightly downward, without theatrical expression.
Constraints: keep all mouth sizes and anatomical shapes close to the source. Make sadness visible through only mild, natural corner tension. A stays fully closed for M/B/P. B narrow consonant with slight teeth; C medium EH; D moderately open AH; E rounded OH; F small OO/W; G upper teeth touching lower lip for F/V; H subtle raised tongue behind upper teeth for L. Keep these as distinct speech forms, not identical frowns. X is closed and mildly subdued, with only a small soft downward corner. Preserve each viseme's natural practical opening and original placement.
Avoid: deep inverted smile, theatrical pout, drooping or enlarged mouth, oversized lips, excessive teeth, exaggerated frown lines, harsh dark outlines, high contrast, airbrush, blur, changed nose/chin/head/hair geometry, altered framing, labels, text, border, missing or reordered cells.
